tabs.content:
// Use 'take' to view a sample number of records in the table and check the data.
table_from_ES1
| take 100

table_from_ES1
| where ArrayIndex_temperature_readings > 1
| project city, country, concatenated = strcat(city, ' ', country)

table_from_ES1
| join kind=leftouter table_from_ES1 on city
| summarize count_of_indexes = count() by country

raw
| order by timestamp asc 
| where todatetime(timestamp) > todatetime('2026-09-05 16:09:40')

Tumbling
| order by Window_End_Time asc

| order by Window_End_Time asc

| order by Window_End_Time asc
